soru:
Tom: I've been feeling exhausted all week.
Anna: ----
Tom: Not really, I've been working until midnight every day.
Anna: No wonder you're tired!
secenekler: Have you been getting enough sleep?
Did you enjoy your holiday?
Why don't you work late tonight?
I've been feeling great lately.
What time does the meeting start?
aciklama: Tom'un 'Not really, gece yarısına kadar çalışıyorum' cevabı, yeterince uyuyup uyumadığının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Researcher: Our results show that the new fertiliser increased crop yields by 30 percent.
Journalist: That's impressive. ----
Researcher: Not so far, but we'll need to study its long-term effects on soil quality before recommending it widely.
Journalist: That sounds sensible.
secenekler: Which crops did you plant last year?
How much does the fertiliser cost?
Why were the results so disappointing?
Have you noticed any negative effects?
When did you start the project?
aciklama: 'Not so far' (şimdilik hayır) cevabı ve uzun vadeli etkilerden söz edilmesi, olumsuz bir etki gözlenip gözlenmediğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Student: I'm thinking of changing my major from engineering to biology.
Advisor: ----
Student: I've realised that I'm much more interested in living systems than in machines.
Advisor: In that case, it might be the right decision.
secenekler: When will you graduate from engineering?
What has made you want to change?
Would you like to take a break?
Engineering is the most popular major.
Have you ever studied chemistry?
aciklama: Öğrenci bölüm değiştirme nedenini açıklıyor; bu yüzden danışman nedenini sormuş olmalıdır.

soru:
Doctor: Your test results are mostly normal, but your cholesterol level is a bit high.
Patient: ----
Doctor: Not at this stage. Let's first see whether changes in your diet and more exercise can bring it down.
Patient: All right, I'll do my best.
secenekler: Should I stop exercising completely?
When will I get the test results?
Is there anything wrong with my blood pressure?
How often should I eat fatty food?
Will I need to take medication for it?
aciklama: Doktorun 'Bu aşamada hayır; önce diyet ve egzersizi deneyelim' cevabı, hastanın ilaç gerekip gerekmediğini sorduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Customer: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?
Assistant: ----
Customer: Great, I'll take it then.
Assistant: Would you like a bag?
secenekler: Sorry, we don't sell jackets.
The fitting rooms are over there.
It's on sale today for half price.
We close at nine o'clock.
It is made of cotton.
aciklama: Müşteri fiyatı soruyor ve 'Great, I'll take it' diyor; cevap fiyatla ilgili ve olumlu olmalıdır.

soru:
Mark: Would you like to join us for dinner on Saturday?
Lisa: ----
Mark: That's a pity. Maybe another time.
Lisa: Definitely.
secenekler: I had dinner with them last Saturday.
I really enjoyed the dinner.
Yes, of course, what time should I come?
I'd love to, but I'm visiting my parents that weekend.
Sure, I'll bring dessert.
aciklama: 'That's a pity. Maybe another time' daveti kibarca reddettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Professor: Have you decided on a topic for your thesis?
Student: I'm thinking of writing about renewable energy in rural areas.
Professor: ----
Student: Yes, I know it's a big topic. I'll focus on solar power in villages.
secenekler: I wrote my thesis many years ago.
Rural areas don't have any energy problems.
Renewable energy is not related to your field.
You should have submitted it last week.
That's quite broad. You might need to narrow it down.
aciklama: Öğrencinin 'it's a big topic' diyip konuyu daraltması, hocanın konunun çok geniş olduğunu söylediğini gösterir.

soru:
Journalist: Your team discovered a new species of frog. How did it happen?
Scientist: ----
Journalist: So it was pure luck?
Scientist: Partly, yes, but we had been surveying the area for months.
secenekler: It took us a long time to name it.
We weren't actually looking for frogs; one jumped into our camp one night.
We used advanced equipment to search for it for many years.
We plan to publish our findings next year.
Frogs are very common in the rainforest.
aciklama: Gazetecinin 'So it was pure luck?' sorusu keşfin tesadüfen olduğunu anlatan bir cevabı gerektirir.

soru:
Patient: I've had a headache for three days now.
Pharmacist: ----
Patient: Yes, but it didn't help much.
Pharmacist: Then I think you should see a doctor.
secenekler: Have you taken any painkillers?
Have you ever been to this pharmacy?
Do you have a prescription for glasses?
How long have you been a patient here?
Is this your first headache ever?
aciklama: 'Yes, but it didn't help much' cevabı daha önce bir şey (ağrı kesici) denendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Manager: Sales dropped by fifteen percent last quarter.
Analyst: ----
Manager: Then we need to find out why customers are switching to them.
Analyst: I'll prepare a report on their pricing and marketing.
secenekler: The economy is growing faster than expected.
Our sales increased in every region.
It seems most of our customers have moved to our main competitor.
The new office will open next month.
We should hire more staff for the sales team.
aciklama: Yöneticinin 'switching to them' sözündeki 'them' zamiri bir rakibe işaret eder; boşlukta rakipten söz edilmelidir.

soru:
Anna: Excuse me, is this seat free?
Man: ----
Anna: Thank you.
Man: You're welcome.
secenekler: I don't like trains.
Yes, please sit down.
It's ten o'clock.
No, I've never been here.
Sorry, I'm a doctor.
aciklama: Anna'nın teşekkür etmesi koltuğun boş olduğunu ve oturmasına izin verildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
Customer: ----
Waiter: Of course. I'll come back in a few minutes.
Customer: Thanks.
secenekler: Can I have the bill, please?
Yes, I'll have the soup, please.
I've already paid.
The food was delicious.
Not yet. Could I have a few more minutes?
aciklama: Garsonun birkaç dakika sonra geleceğini söylemesi müşterinin henüz hazır olmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Tom: How was your weekend?
Sara: ----
Tom: Really? Where did you go?
Sara: To a small village by the sea.
secenekler: Terrible, I stayed at home all weekend.
I don't like weekends.
Great! We went on a short trip.
It's Monday today.
I'm going to work this weekend.
aciklama: 'Where did you go?' sorusu Sara'nın bir yere gittiğini söylediğini gösterir.

soru:
Receptionist: Good morning, how can I help you?
Guest: ----
Receptionist: Certainly. May I see your passport, please?
Guest: Here you are.
secenekler: The breakfast was excellent.
I'm leaving the hotel tomorrow.
Where is the nearest bank?
I have a reservation under the name Smith.
I lost my way yesterday.
aciklama: Pasaport istenmesi otele giriş (rezervasyon) işlemine uyar.

soru:
Mother: Have you finished your homework?
Son: ----
Mother: Then you can't watch TV until it's done.
Son: OK, I'll do it now.
secenekler: Not yet, I still have maths to do.
Yes, I finished it an hour ago.
I watched TV yesterday.
I don't have any homework today.
The teacher was ill today.
aciklama: 'Then you can't watch TV until it's done' ödevin bitmediğini gösterir.

soru:
Lisa: I'm going to the supermarket. Do you need anything?
Kate: ----
Lisa: Sure. Anything else?
Kate: No, that's all. Thanks.
secenekler: I've already had lunch.
Could you get me some milk?
I don't like shopping.
The supermarket closes at nine.
No, I went there yesterday.
aciklama: 'Sure. Anything else?' bir şey istendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: Excuse me, where is the library?
Teacher: ----
Student: Thank you very much.
Teacher: You're welcome.
secenekler: It opens at nine.
I've read that book.
It's on the second floor, next to the computer room.
You can borrow three books.
The library is very quiet.
aciklama: 'Where' sorusuna yer bildiren cevap verilmelidir.

soru:
Man: I'd like to send this parcel to Germany.
Clerk: ----
Man: Just some books.
Clerk: That will be 30 euros.
secenekler: When did you buy it?
Are you from Germany?
Do you like reading?
What's inside it?
How old are you?
aciklama: 'Just some books' cevabı paketin içeriğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Ali: Would you like some more tea?
Mehmet: ----
Ali: Are you sure? There's plenty.
Mehmet: Yes, really. I've had three cups already.
secenekler: I prefer coffee in the morning.
Tea is grown in Rize.
Yes, please. I'd love some.
I didn't sleep well.
No, thanks. I'm fine.
aciklama: 'Are you sure? There's plenty' ısrarı ikramın reddedildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Doctor: What seems to be the problem?
Patient: ----
Doctor: How long have you had it?
Patient: Since last Tuesday.
secenekler: I've got a terrible sore throat.
I feel much better now, thanks.
I don't have any problems.
My appointment is at three.
I'd like to change my doctor.
aciklama: 'How long have you had it?' bir şikâyetin söylendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Emma: I can't find my phone anywhere.
Jack: ----
Emma: Good idea. Oh, I can hear it! It's under the sofa.
Jack: Great.
secenekler: I don't have a phone.
It was very expensive.
You should buy a new one.
Why don't I call it?
Phones are bad for your health.
aciklama: 'Good idea ... I can hear it' telefonun aranmasını öneren cevabı gerektirir.

soru:
Customer: Do you have this shirt in a larger size?
Assistant: ----
Customer: That's a pity. Can you order one for me?
Assistant: Yes, it will arrive in three days.
secenekler: I'm afraid we've sold out of large ones.
Yes, here you are.
It's on sale today.
The changing rooms are over there.
It's made of cotton.
aciklama: 'That's a pity' büyük bedenin kalmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Teacher: Why are you late?
Student: ----
Teacher: All right, but try to leave home earlier next time.
Student: I will.
secenekler: I finished my homework.
I don't want to come to school.
I'm never late.
The lesson is boring.
I'm sorry, the bus broke down.
aciklama: Öğretmenin kabul edip uyarması geçerli bir mazeret sunulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Sam: What would you like to drink?
Joe: ----
Sam: Hot or iced?
Joe: Hot, please.
secenekler: I've already eaten.
Some bread, please.
A coffee, please.
Water is healthy.
I'm not hungry.
aciklama: 'Hot or iced?' sıcak ya da soğuk içilebilen bir içecek istendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Clerk: How would you like to pay?
Customer: ----
Clerk: Please enter your PIN.
Customer: Sure.
secenekler: In cash, please.
By card, please.
I'll pay tomorrow.
How much is it?
I don't have any money.
aciklama: PIN girilmesi kartla ödeme yapıldığını gösterir.

soru:
Kim: I passed my driving test!
Lee: ----
Kim: Thanks! I was so nervous.
Lee: You must be very happy.
secenekler: I'm sorry to hear that.
Good luck!
Never mind.
What a pity!
Congratulations!
aciklama: İyi habere verilen uygun tepki tebriktir.

soru:
Interviewer: Why do you want to work for our company?
Candidate: ----
Interviewer: That's good to hear. What experience do you have in that area?
Candidate: I worked on two similar projects in my previous job.
secenekler: I'm very interested in your work on renewable energy.
I don't really know much about the company.
I heard the salary is very high.
I need a job because I'm unemployed.
Your office is close to my house.
aciklama: 'that area' bir çalışma alanına gönderme yapar; yalnızca yenilenebilir enerji seçeneği bir alan belirtir.

soru:
Professor: Your essay was well written, but the conclusion was rather weak.
Student: ----
Professor: You could summarise your main arguments and suggest areas for further research.
Student: Thank you, I'll try that.
secenekler: Why did you give me a high mark?
Can I write about a different topic?
How could I improve it?
When is the deadline?
Did other students do better?
aciklama: Profesörün öneri sunması öğrencinin nasıl geliştirebileceğini sorduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Journalist: Many people say the new bridge is unsafe.
Engineer: ----
Journalist: So why are there cracks in the concrete?
Engineer: Those are surface cracks; they don't affect the structure.
secenekler: Bridges are usually made of steel.
The bridge was designed by a famous architect.
I've never seen the bridge myself.
That's not true. It has passed every safety test.
I agree. It should be closed immediately.
aciklama: Gazetecinin 'So why are there cracks?' diye itiraz etmesi mühendisin köprünün güvenli olduğunu savunduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Manager: We need to reduce our costs by ten percent next year.
Employee: ----
Manager: No, I'd rather avoid that. Let's look at energy and travel expenses first.
Employee: That makes sense.
secenekler: Our sales increased last year.
Does that mean some people will lose their jobs?
Should we hire more staff?
I'll take a holiday next month.
The new office looks great.
aciklama: 'No, I'd rather avoid that' işten çıkarma gibi istenmeyen bir önlemin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Tourist: Is it safe to swim here?
Lifeguard: ----
Tourist: Where can I swim, then?
Lifeguard: The beach on the other side of the bay is much calmer.
secenekler: I'm a good swimmer.
You need a ticket to swim.
Not today; the currents are too strong.
Yes, it's perfectly safe.
The water is very warm.
aciklama: 'Where can I swim, then?' burada yüzmenin güvenli olmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Scientist: We've found traces of water on the planet's surface.
Reporter: ----
Scientist: Not necessarily, but it makes the possibility more likely.
Reporter: That's exciting news.
secenekler: Does that mean there is life there?
Is the planet bigger than Earth?
Who paid for the mission?
When did you start the project?
How far away is the planet?
aciklama: 'Not necessarily ... the possibility' cevabı bir olasılığın (yaşam) sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Neighbour: Your dog barked all night again.
Mark: ----
Neighbour: I understand, but it's hard to sleep with the noise.
Mark: I'll ask a trainer to help.
secenekler: You should get a dog too.
I didn't hear anything, so it wasn't my dog.
My dog never barks.
Dogs are better than cats.
I'm really sorry. He gets anxious when he's alone.
aciklama: 'I understand, but ...' bir özür ve açıklamaya verilen tepkidir.

soru:
Student A: Are you coming to the lecture tomorrow?
Student B: ----
Student A: Don't worry, I'll lend you my notes.
Student B: Thanks, that's really kind of you.
secenekler: Of course, I never miss a lecture.
I can't. I have a doctor's appointment.
The lecture was boring yesterday.
I've already taken notes.
Who is giving the lecture?
aciklama: Not ödünç verme teklifi B'nin derse gelemeyeceğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: I bought this laptop last week, and it keeps switching off.
Assistant: ----
Customer: I'd prefer a refund, actually.
Assistant: No problem. Do you have your receipt?
secenekler: You should have bought a more expensive one.
We don't sell laptops here.
That's the most popular model.
Would you like us to repair it or replace it?
Laptops usually last for years.
aciklama: 'I'd prefer a refund, actually' sunulan seçeneklere (onarım/değişim) verilen bir cevaptır.

soru:
Tour guide: This castle was built in the twelfth century.
Visitor: ----
Guide: Yes, about a hundred people still live inside the walls.
Visitor: How fascinating!
secenekler: Was it destroyed in a war?
Does anyone live there today?
How much is the entrance fee?
Who built it?
Can we take photos?
aciklama: Rehberin cevabı kalede hâlâ insanların yaşadığıdır; soru bunu sormalıdır.

soru:
Coach: You played well today, but you need to work on your fitness.
Player: ----
Coach: Start by running three times a week and add strength training later.
Player: I'll start tomorrow.
secenekler: I think I played badly.
Can I take a week off?
When is the next match?
Why did we lose the match?
What do you suggest I do?
aciklama: Antrenörün öneri vermesi oyuncunun ne yapması gerektiğini sorduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Passenger: Excuse me, does this bus go to the city centre?
Driver: ----
Passenger: Which one should I take, then?
Driver: Number 12. It stops just across the road.
secenekler: It leaves every ten minutes.
The fare is two euros.
Please sit at the back.
No, it goes to the airport.
Yes, it stops right in the centre.
aciklama: 'Which one should I take, then?' bu otobüsün merkeze gitmediğini gösterir.

soru:
Friend A: I've decided to learn Spanish.
Friend B: ----
Friend A: Mainly because I'm planning to work in South America next year.
Friend B: That's a great reason.
secenekler: When did you come back?
I can't speak Spanish.
What made you decide that?
How long have you been learning it?
Spanish is spoken in Spain.
aciklama: 'Mainly because ...' cevabı nedenin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Mia: Did you watch the match last night?
Leo: ----
Mia: You missed a great game, then! We won 3–0.
Leo: Oh no, I'll watch the highlights.
secenekler: No, I had to work late.
Who played in the match?
The tickets were expensive.
Yes, it was fantastic!
I don't like football at all.
aciklama: 'You missed a great game' Leo'nun maçı izlemediğini, özetleri izleyecek olması da futbolla ilgilendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Visitor: Is photography allowed in the museum?
Guard: ----
Visitor: Can I use my phone, then?
Guard: Yes, as long as the flash is switched off.
secenekler: Only without flash.
Yes, you can use any camera with flash.
The museum closes at six.
Tickets are sold at the entrance.
The gift shop is on the left.
aciklama: Görevlinin son cevabı flaşsız çekime izin verildiğini gösterir; bu, ilk cevapla tutarlıdır.

soru:
Reporter: The government claims unemployment has fallen.
Economist: ----
Reporter: So the figures are misleading?
Economist: To some extent. Many of the new jobs are part-time or temporary.
secenekler: I don't know anything about unemployment.
That's true, but the quality of the new jobs is another matter.
The government always tells the truth.
Unemployment is not related to the economy.
Yes, and wages have risen significantly too.
aciklama: Muhabirin 'misleading' sorusu ve 'To some extent' cevabı, ekonomistin rakamları kabul edip bir çekince koyduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Patient: The doctor said I need an operation, but I'm not sure.
Nurse: ----
Patient: That's a good idea. I'd feel more confident.
Nurse: I can give you a list of specialists.
secenekler: Operations are always dangerous.
The doctor is never wrong.
Why don't you get a second opinion?
I had the same operation last year.
You should have it done immediately.
aciklama: 'That's a good idea' ve uzman listesi, başka bir doktora danışma önerisini gerektirir.

soru:
Professor: Your results contradict most previous studies.
Researcher: ----
Professor: Then you should explain that clearly in your paper.
Researcher: I will.
secenekler: That's why I stopped the project.
I haven't read any previous studies.
Yes, so I'll change my results.
I know, but our sample was much larger and more diverse.
Previous studies were all mine.
aciklama: 'Then you should explain that' araştırmacının farkı açıklayan bir gerekçe sunduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Architect: We could save money by using cheaper materials.
Client: ----
Architect: Not necessarily, but the building would need more maintenance.
Client: Then let's keep the original plan.
secenekler: Can we use more glass?
I'd like a bigger building.
How much would we save?
When will the building be finished?
Wouldn't that make the building less safe?
aciklama: 'Not necessarily' cevabı olası bir olumsuzluğun (güvenlik) sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Student: I'm thinking of taking a gap year before university.
Advisor: ----
Student: I'd like to volunteer abroad and improve my languages.
Advisor: That sounds very worthwhile.
secenekler: What would you do during that year?
You should start university immediately.
Gap years are always a waste of time.
How were your exam results?
Which university have you chosen?
aciklama: Öğrencinin planlarını anlatması o yıl ne yapacağının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Farmer: The drought has destroyed most of my crops this year.
Official: ----
Farmer: How do I apply?
Official: Fill in this form and attach photos of the damage.
secenekler: Next year will certainly be better.
Droughts are very rare in this region.
Water is very expensive now.
The government is offering compensation to affected farmers.
You should have planted different crops.
aciklama: 'How do I apply?' başvurulabilecek bir yardımdan söz edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Passenger: My suitcase didn't arrive on the flight from Madrid.
Clerk: ----
Passenger: It's a large blue one with a red ribbon on the handle.
Clerk: Thank you. We'll contact you as soon as it's found.
secenekler: Would you like a window seat?
Which gate did your flight leave from?
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you describe it, please?
Your flight has been cancelled.
How much did the suitcase cost?
aciklama: Yolcunun bavulunu tarif etmesi, görevlinin bavulun tarifini istediğini gösterir.

soru:
Patient: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Aydın, please.
Receptionist: ----
Patient: Tuesday morning would be ideal, if possible.
Receptionist: She has a free slot at ten o'clock.
secenekler: What seems to be the problem?
Have you taken any medicine?
She retired last year.
Please take a seat in the waiting room.
Certainly. When would suit you?
aciklama: Hastanın gün ve saat belirtmesi, kendisine ne zaman uygun olduğunun sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Emma: Have you finished the novel for the book club yet?
Leo: ----
Emma: Really? I thought you were enjoying it.
Leo: I was at first, but the second half is so slow that I lost interest.
secenekler: The book club meets on Thursdays.
No, and to be honest, I've given up on it.
Yes, I read it in one night because I loved it.
I haven't bought it yet.
Yes, it's the best book I've ever read.
aciklama: Emma'nın şaşırması ve Leo'nun ilgisini kaybettiğini söylemesi kitabı bıraktığını gösterir.

soru:
Tenant: My electricity bill has almost doubled this month.
Landlord: ----
Tenant: No, I've been using it as little as possible.
Landlord: Then perhaps there's a problem with the meter. I'll ask someone to check it.
secenekler: Have you been using the electric heater a lot?
Electricity prices never change.
Why don't you move to a bigger flat?
You should pay it by Friday.
I'll raise your rent next month.
aciklama: 'No, I've been using it as little as possible' cevabı bir cihazın çok kullanılıp kullanılmadığının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Interviewer: Why do you want to leave your current job?
Candidate: ----
Interviewer: I see. And what kind of challenges are you looking for?
Candidate: I'd like to manage larger projects and lead a team.
secenekler: I haven't started working yet.
I'm happy there and don't want to leave.
Because the salary here is lower.
I feel I've learnt all I can there, and I'm ready for new challenges.
My manager asked me to apply here.
aciklama: Görüşmecinin 'what kind of challenges' sorusu adayın yeni zorluklardan söz ettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: I'd like to book a table for six on Saturday evening.
Waiter: ----
Customer: Around eight, if you have anything then.
Waiter: I'm afraid we're full at eight, but we could offer you half past eight.
secenekler: We're closed on Saturdays.
Of course. What time would you like?
Would you like to see the dessert menu?
That will be forty euros, please.
How would you like your steak?
aciklama: Müşterinin 'Around eight' diye saat belirtmesi saatin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Teacher: Your project on water filters was very impressive.
Student: ----
Teacher: You should be proud. It's clear you put a lot of work into it.
secenekler: Water filters are too expensive.
Can I change my project topic?
I didn't do any work on it.
I'm sorry it was so disappointing.
Thank you. It took us nearly two months to finish.
aciklama: Öğretmenin 'you put a lot of work into it' demesi öğrencinin harcadığı emekten söz ettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: I'd like to rent a car for a week.
Agent: ----
Customer: Something small and economical. I'll mostly be driving in the city.
Agent: Then I'd recommend this model. It uses very little fuel.
secenekler: We only rent vans.
The car must be returned tomorrow.
Certainly. What kind of car are you looking for?
Have you ever had an accident?
Where would you like to fly to?
aciklama: Müşterinin istediği araba türünü tarif etmesi, türün sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Mia: We're organising a beach clean-up this Sunday. Would you like to join us?
Tom: ----
Mia: That's fine. We'll be there all day, so come whenever you're free.
secenekler: Why didn't you invite me earlier?
No, I hate the beach and never go there.
I'd love to, but I can only come in the afternoon.
I went to the beach last Sunday.
Is the beach very far from the city?
aciklama: Mia'nın 'come whenever you're free' demesi Tom'un yalnızca belirli bir saatte gelebileceğini söylediğini gösterir.

soru:
Anna: Could you please keep the music down after midnight?
Ben: ----
Anna: Thanks. I have an early exam tomorrow.
secenekler: The neighbours never complain.
What kind of music do you like?
I can't hear anything.
I always listen to music after midnight.
Sorry, I didn't realise it was so loud. I'll turn it down.
aciklama: Anna'nın teşekkür etmesi Ben'in isteği kabul ettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: The shoes I ordered online are too small.
Assistant: ----
Customer: Yes, I'd prefer a larger size rather than my money back.
Assistant: No problem. I'll send you a pair in size 42.
secenekler: Those shoes are very popular.
Would you like to exchange them?
Did you pay by credit card?
We don't accept returns on shoes.
Have you tried wearing them outside?
aciklama: Müşterinin para iadesi yerine daha büyük numara istemesi değişim teklif edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: I missed yesterday's lecture because I was ill.
Professor: ----
Student: Thank you. I'll download them tonight.
secenekler: Attendance is not compulsory.
The lecture was cancelled anyway.
Did you see a doctor?
The slides are available on the course website.
You'll have to repeat the course.
aciklama: 'I'll download them' ifadesi indirilebilecek bir şeyden, yani slaytlardan söz edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: Can you fix my bike by tomorrow?
Mechanic: ----
Customer: Oh no. I need it to get to work.
Mechanic: I can lend you one of ours until yours is ready.
secenekler: I'm afraid not. The part won't arrive until Friday.
Your bike looks brand new.
Of course. It'll be ready in an hour.
How long have you had this bike?
We don't sell bicycles.
aciklama: Müşterinin 'Oh no' tepkisi ve ödünç bisiklet teklifi tamirin yetişmeyeceğini gösterir.

soru:
Sara: I heard you're moving to Izmir.
Can: ----
Sara: That's great news. Congratulations!
secenekler: Yes, I've been offered a job at a hospital there.
No, I've never been to Izmir.
Yes, but I'm really worried because I lost my job.
I don't know anyone who lives in Izmir.
Izmir is too hot in the summer.
aciklama: 'Congratulations!' ancak iyi bir habere, örneğin iş teklifine verilen bir tepkidir.

soru:
Mother: How did the maths exam go?
Son: ----
Mother: Don't worry. As long as you did your best, that's what matters.
secenekler: It was great. I think I got full marks.
The exam is next week.
Not very well, I'm afraid. I ran out of time.
I didn't have a maths exam.
Maths is my favourite subject.
aciklama: Annenin teselli etmesi sınavın kötü geçtiğini gösterir.

soru:
Organiser: The keynote speaker has just cancelled.
Assistant: ----
Organiser: Good idea. Could you call her right away?
secenekler: The speaker's flight has just landed.
Then we should cancel the whole conference.
How many people have registered?
I'm sure she'll come anyway.
Why don't we ask Professor Demir to take her place?
aciklama: 'Good idea' ve 'call her' bir öneri ve aranacak yeni bir kişiden söz edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Barista: What can I get you?
Customer: ----
Barista: Sorry, we've run out of oat milk. Would soya milk be all right?
secenekler: A black coffee, no milk, please.
Do you sell sandwiches?
Where's the nearest cash machine?
A large latte with oat milk, please.
Just a glass of water, thanks.
aciklama: Baristanın yulaf sütünün bittiğini söylemesi müşterinin yulaf sütü istediğini gösterir.

soru:
Passenger: Excuse me, why hasn't boarding started yet?
Staff: ----
Passenger: How long will we have to wait?
Staff: At least an hour, I'm afraid.
secenekler: This flight is going to Rome.
The plane is being checked because of a technical problem.
Your seat is 14A.
You can't take liquids on board.
Boarding finished twenty minutes ago.
aciklama: Yolcu gecikmenin nedenini soruyor; ardından bekleme süresini sorması bir sorun olduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Receptionist: Welcome to the gym. Are you a member?
Visitor: ----
Receptionist: Then you'll need to fill in this form and show some ID.
secenekler: Not yet, but I'd like to join.
Where are the changing rooms?
Is the swimming pool open?
Yes, I've been coming here for years.
I'm just waiting for a friend.
aciklama: Form doldurma istenmesi ziyaretçinin üye olmak istediğini gösterir.

soru:
Manager: Will the report be ready by Friday?
Employee: ----
Manager: All right, but no later than Tuesday, please.
secenekler: I'll send it to you tomorrow.
I'm not sure. Could I have until early next week?
What report are you talking about?
I've already sent it to the client.
Yes, I finished it this morning.
aciklama: Müdürün 'no later than Tuesday' demesi çalışanın ek süre istediğini gösterir.

soru:
Leyla: Shall we watch a comedy tonight?
Mert: ----
Leyla: Fine, but nothing too frightening, please.
secenekler: I watched a comedy yesterday and loved it.
The cinema is closed tonight.
Yes, a comedy sounds perfect.
I'd rather watch a thriller, actually.
I don't have a television.
aciklama: Leyla'nın 'nothing too frightening' demesi Mert'in korku ya da gerilim türünde bir film önerdiğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: I'd like to borrow this book, but my library card has expired.
Librarian: ----
Student: That's easy. I have my student ID with me.
secenekler: Would you like a plastic bag?
I'm sorry, this book cannot be borrowed.
You can renew it here if you show some identification.
You'll have to pay a fine for late books.
The library closes at six.
aciklama: Öğrencinin kimliğini göstermesi kimlik istendiğini gösterir.

soru:
Deniz: The forecast says it'll rain all weekend.
Ece: ----
Deniz: Good idea. We could go to the new science museum.
secenekler: Let's go to the beach, then.
I love walking in the rain.
Great, it'll be perfect weather for a picnic.
The forecast is always wrong.
Then let's plan something indoors instead of the picnic.
aciklama: Deniz'in kapalı bir mekân olan müzeyi önermesi Ece'nin kapalı alan etkinliği önerdiğini gösterir.

soru:
Receptionist: Which level would you like to join?
Student: ----
Receptionist: In that case, you should take a short placement test first.
secenekler: The beginners' class, please. I've never studied German.
Advanced, please. I've already passed the official exam.
I'm not sure. I studied German years ago but forgot most of it.
How much does the course cost?
Are the classes in the evening?
aciklama: Seviye tespit sınavı önerisi öğrencinin seviyesinden emin olmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Volunteer: We're collecting warm clothes for families affected by the earthquake.
Resident: ----
Volunteer: Anything clean and in good condition would be very welcome.
secenekler: Where can I buy warm clothes?
I haven't heard about the earthquake.
When will the earthquake happen?
I'd like to help. What sort of clothes do you need?
I'm afraid I'm too busy to talk.
aciklama: Gönüllünün ne tür kıyafet kabul ettiklerini açıklaması kıyafet türünün sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Husband: What colour should we paint the living room?
Wife: ----
Husband: I agree. Dark colours would make it look even smaller.
secenekler: Let's not paint it at all.
Dark blue would look lovely.
I'll buy the paint tomorrow.
The kitchen needs painting more.
Something light, like cream or pale yellow.
aciklama: Kocanın koyu renklerin odayı küçülteceğini söyleyerek onaylaması açık bir renk önerildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Woman: I think I left my wallet on the bus this morning.
Officer: ----
Woman: It was the number 25, at about half past eight.
Officer: I'll contact the bus company and let you know.
secenekler: How much money was in it?
Which bus were you on, and at what time?
Have you checked your pockets?
Did you report it to your bank?
Where do you live?
aciklama: Kadının otobüs numarası ve saati vermesi bunların sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Selin: Where are you going on holiday this year?
Arda: ----
Selin: Lucky you! I've always wanted to see the northern lights.
secenekler: We're going to Norway in February.
I haven't decided yet.
We're staying at home to save money.
We're going to Egypt to see the pyramids.
We went to Italy last year.
aciklama: Kuzey ışıklarından söz edilmesi Norveç gibi kuzeyde bir yere gidildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Kerem: I don't think Ali is doing his share of the group project.
Zeynep: ----
Kerem: You're right. It's better to talk to him first before we tell the teacher.
secenekler: Ali is the hardest-working member of our group.
The project is due next month.
Let's report him to the teacher immediately.
I've already finished my part.
Maybe we should ask him if something is wrong.
aciklama: Kerem'in önce Ali ile konuşmayı onaylaması Zeynep'in onunla konuşmayı önerdiğini gösterir.

soru:
Tenant: Is it possible to keep a pet in the flat?
Agent: ----
Tenant: That's fine. My cat is very quiet.
secenekler: The flat has two bedrooms.
No, pets are strictly forbidden.
Do you have children?
Small pets are allowed, but you'll need the owner's permission.
The rent includes heating.
aciklama: Kiracının 'That's fine' diyerek kedisinden söz etmesi evcil hayvana koşullu izin verildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Doctor: Your test results are all normal.
Patient: ----
Doctor: Then it's probably just stress. Try to get more rest.
secenekler: But why do I still feel so tired all the time?
Great, so I feel perfectly healthy.
I'd like to change my doctor.
How much do the tests cost?
When will I get the results?
aciklama: Doktorun stres ve dinlenmeden söz etmesi hastanın süregelen yorgunluğundan yakındığını gösterir.

soru:
Teacher: How long have you been playing the violin?
Pupil: ----
Teacher: That's impressive progress for such a short time.
secenekler: Since I was four years old.
My sister plays the piano.
Only about six months.
I practise every morning.
I don't play the violin.
aciklama: 'such a short time' ifadesi öğrencinin kısa bir süredir çaldığını gösterir.

soru:
Guest: The air conditioning in my room isn't working.
Receptionist: ----
Guest: That would be great. I'd rather not wait for it to be repaired.
secenekler: All our rooms have air conditioning.
I'm very sorry. Would you like to move to another room?
Would you like a wake-up call?
I'll send a technician first thing tomorrow.
Breakfast is served until ten.
aciklama: Misafirin tamiri beklemek istemediğini söyleyip teklifi kabul etmesi oda değişikliği önerildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Emre: The food in the canteen has got much better this term.
Aslı: ----
Emre: Really? Maybe you should try the vegetarian menu. It's excellent.
secenekler: I don't agree. I still find it rather tasteless.
I always eat at the canteen.
The prices have gone up too.
The canteen is closed this term.
Yes, it's delicious now.
aciklama: Emre'nin 'Really?' diye şaşırıp başka menü önermesi Aslı'nın katılmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Ahmet: Could I borrow your car this weekend?
Burak: ----
Ahmet: No problem. I'll fill it up before I bring it back.
secenekler: Where are you planning to go?
Sorry, I sold it last month.
I need it myself this weekend.
My car is in the garage for repairs.
Sure, but the tank is almost empty.
aciklama: Ahmet'in depoyu dolduracağını söylemesi yakıtın az olduğundan söz edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Agent: Would you like to add travel insurance to your booking?
Customer: ----
Agent: It covers cancellations, lost luggage and medical costs abroad.
secenekler: Can I choose my seat?
How long is the flight?
What exactly does it cover?
Yes, please. How much is it?
No, thanks. I already have insurance.
aciklama: Görevlinin sigortanın kapsamını açıklaması kapsamın sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Coach: How is your training for the marathon going?
Runner: ----
Coach: Then you should rest for a few days. Running on an injury will only make it worse.
secenekler: The marathon is in April.
Not great. My knee has been hurting since last week.
I've decided not to run it.
Perfectly. I ran thirty kilometres yesterday.
I bought new running shoes.
aciklama: Antrenörün sakatlıktan söz etmesi koşucunun bir ağrıdan yakındığını gösterir.

soru:
Researcher: Would you mind answering a few questions about public transport?
Passer-by: ----
Researcher: It'll only take about five minutes.
secenekler: No, I never use public transport.
I've already answered your questions.
Where is the nearest bus stop?
That depends. How long will it take?
Are you from the local council?
aciklama: Araştırmacının süre belirtmesi ne kadar süreceğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Nazlı: What did you think of the exhibition?
Oğuz: ----
Nazlı: I felt exactly the same. The early paintings were much more interesting.
secenekler: I didn't have time to go.
I loved every single painting.
Honestly, I was a bit disappointed by the recent works.
It was too crowded to see anything.
The tickets were very cheap.
aciklama: Nazlı'nın erken dönem resimleri daha ilginç bulduğunu söyleyerek katılması Oğuz'un yeni eserleri beğenmediğini gösterir.

soru:
New neighbour: Hi, I've just moved in next door.
Resident: ----
New neighbour: Thanks. Actually, could you tell me when the rubbish is collected?
secenekler: I'm moving out next week.
Welcome! Let me know if you need anything.
The previous tenants were very rude.
Have you paid the rent yet?
Please keep the noise down.
aciklama: Yeni komşunun teşekkür edip hemen bir şey sorması yardım teklif edildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: I can't decide between studying medicine and engineering.
Counsellor: ----
Student: Well, I enjoy biology, but I'm also good at physics.
secenekler: Engineering is too difficult for most students.
Have you applied to any universities?
You should decide by tomorrow.
Which subjects do you enjoy most at school?
Medicine is much better paid.
aciklama: Öğrencinin sevdiği dersleri anlatması hangi dersleri sevdiğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Passenger: Excuse me, does this bus go to the airport?
Driver: ----
Passenger: Oh, I see. Where can I catch it?
Driver: From the stop across the road.
secenekler: No, you need the number 12.
The airport is closed today.
Tickets cost five lira.
Yes, it takes about forty minutes.
Please move to the back of the bus.
aciklama: 'Where can I catch it?' sorusu başka bir otobüsün önerildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Irmak: Let's organise a surprise party for Duru's birthday.
Kaan: ----
Irmak: Don't worry, I'll ask her sister to keep her busy all afternoon.
secenekler: I've already bought her a present.
Let's invite only a few people.
Her birthday was last month.
Duru hates birthday parties.
Good idea, but how will we keep it secret from her?
aciklama: Irmak'ın Duru'yu oyalama planı partinin gizli tutulmasıyla ilgili bir endişeye cevaptır.

soru:
User: The app keeps crashing whenever I try to upload a photo.
Support: ----
User: Yes, I installed the latest version yesterday.
Support: In that case, please send us a screenshot of the error message.
secenekler: How many photos do you have?
Which phone would you like to buy?
Could you uninstall your camera?
Our app does not support photos.
Have you updated the app recently?
aciklama: Kullanıcının son sürümü yüklediğini söylemesi güncelleme yapılıp yapılmadığının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Guest: This soup is delicious! What's in it?
Host: ----
Guest: I'd never have guessed. I must ask you for the recipe.
secenekler: It's made with pumpkin, ginger and a little coconut milk.
I bought it from the supermarket.
Would you like some more bread?
It's my grandmother's favourite dish.
I'm glad you like it, but it's too salty.
aciklama: Konuğun malzemeleri tahmin edemeyeceğini söylemesi içindekilerin sayıldığını gösterir.

soru:
Nutritionist: How often do you eat fruit and vegetables?
Client: ----
Nutritionist: That's not enough. You should aim for at least five portions a day.
secenekler: I drink lots of water.
At every meal, usually.
Maybe once or twice a week.
I'm allergic to nuts.
I go to the gym three times a week.
aciklama: 'That's not enough' ifadesi danışanın az sıklıkta tükettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Passenger A: Excuse me, has the 9:15 to Ankara left yet?
Passenger B: ----
Passenger A: Oh, what a relief. I thought I had missed it.
secenekler: You need to buy a ticket first.
This train goes to Istanbul.
Yes, it left ten minutes ago.
No, it's been delayed by twenty minutes.
I'm not sure. I'm not from around here.
aciklama: Rahatlama ifadesi trenin henüz kalkmadığını gösterir.

soru:
Ali: I've never been skiing before. Is it hard to learn?
Instructor: ----
Ali: That's reassuring. I was worried I'd spend the whole week falling over.
secenekler: Skiing is the most dangerous sport.
Not really. Most beginners can ski down easy slopes after a couple of days.
You should have started as a child.
The ski season has ended.
Yes, most people give up after the first day.
aciklama: 'That's reassuring' cevabı eğitmenin rahatlatıcı bir şey söylediğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: Is it possible to do my internship in the summer?
Coordinator: ----
Student: That's great. I'll start looking for a company then.
secenekler: Yes, as long as it lasts at least six weeks.
Summer is the best time for holidays.
No, internships only take place in the autumn.
The company has no vacancies.
You've already completed your internship.
aciklama: Öğrencinin sevinip şirket aramaya başlayacağını söylemesi olumlu bir cevap verildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Resident: The council wants to cut down the old trees in the park.
Neighbour: ----
Resident: Exactly. Let's collect signatures and present them at the next meeting.
secenekler: I didn't know there was a park here.
Good. Those trees block the view.
Which park do you mean?
That's terrible. We should do something to stop them.
The council meets every month.
aciklama: 'Exactly' ve imza toplama önerisi komşunun buna karşı çıkıp harekete geçmeyi önerdiğini gösterir.

soru:
Passenger: How long will it take to get to the stadium?
Driver: ----
Passenger: In that case, let's take the coast road instead.
secenekler: It costs about a hundred lira.
The match starts at seven.
About ten minutes. There's no traffic at all.
I don't know where the stadium is.
At least forty minutes, because the main road is blocked.
aciklama: Yolcunun başka yol önermesi ana yolda bir sorun olduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Zehra: I didn't get the scholarship I applied for.
Deniz: ----
Zehra: Thanks. You're right, I can apply again next year.
secenekler: I got the scholarship too.
I'm sorry. But don't give up; there'll be other chances.
Scholarships are not important.
Why did you apply for it?
Congratulations! You deserve it.
aciklama: Zehra'nın gelecek yıl yeniden başvurabileceğini söylemesi cesaretlendirildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: Excuse me, do you have this jacket in a medium?
Assistant: Let me check... I'm sorry, we only have small and large.
Customer: ----
Assistant: Of course. It should arrive within three days.
secenekler: Where can I pay for it?
I bought it last week.
Could you order a medium for me?
Great, I'll take the medium then.
Thank you, it fits perfectly.
aciklama: Görevlinin üç gün içinde geleceğini söylemesi müşterinin sipariş istediğini gösterir.

soru:
Lara: ----
Ozan: I'd love to, but I've already made plans for Saturday.
Lara: Never mind. Maybe another time.
secenekler: Have you ever been to Paris?
Why are you always late?
Would you like to come to my house for dinner on Saturday?
Can you help me with my homework now?
What did you do last Saturday?
aciklama: Ozan'ın 'I'd love to, but' diyerek cumartesiden söz etmesi cumartesi için bir davet yapıldığını gösterir.

soru:
Driver: Excuse me, can I park here?
Attendant: ----
Driver: Oh, I didn't see the sign. Where's the nearest car park?
Attendant: Just around the corner, next to the bank.
secenekler: I'm afraid not. This area is for residents only.
The bank closes at five.
Please show me your ticket.
Your car is very nice.
Yes, you can park here for free.
aciklama: Sürücünün tabelayı görmediğini söyleyip başka otopark sorması park etmenin yasak olduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Customer: I'm looking for a camera that's easy to carry when I travel.
Assistant: ----
Customer: It's very light. How much does it cost?
secenekler: This professional camera weighs about two kilos.
We don't sell cameras here.
Where are you travelling to?
This compact model might suit you.
Do you already have a camera?
aciklama: Müşterinin 'It's very light' demesi hafif bir modelin önerildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Student: The heating in my dorm room doesn't work.
Warden: ----
Student: Since Monday. It's been freezing.
secenekler: Which room are you in?
Did you pay the fees?
Have you tried opening the window?
Heating is turned off in summer.
How long has it been like this?
aciklama: 'Since Monday' cevabı sorunun ne zamandan beri sürdüğünün sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Eda: The film festival starts next week. Are you going?
Bora: I'd like to, but the tickets are really expensive.
Eda: ----
Bora: Really? That's great. I'll get mine today.
secenekler: The festival has been cancelled.
Actually, students can get them at half price.
I'm not going either.
I've already seen all the films.
Yes, they cost more than last year.
aciklama: Bora'nın sevinip biletini alacağını söylemesi bilet fiyatıyla ilgili iyi bir haber verildiğini gösterir.

soru:
Customer: My laptop won't turn on.
Technician: ----
Customer: Yes, I spilt some coffee on it yesterday.
Technician: That explains it. The keyboard may need replacing.
secenekler: Would you like a new mouse?
Has anything happened to it recently?
What operating system does it use?
How old is your laptop?
Did you buy it here?
aciklama: Müşterinin kahve döktüğünü söylemesi yakın zamanda bir olay olup olmadığının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Employee: ----
HR officer: Yes, it covers your spouse and children as well.
Employee: That's good to know. Thanks.
secenekler: Can I work from home on Fridays?
When is the next staff meeting?
Does the company's health insurance cover my family?
How many days of holiday do I have?
Where is the HR office?
aciklama: 'it covers your spouse and children' cevabı sigortanın aileyi kapsayıp kapsamadığının sorulduğunu gösterir.

soru:
Child: Mum, can we take this kitten home?
Mother: ----
Child: I promise I'll feed it and clean up after it every day.
secenekler: Kittens don't like milk.
Where did you find it?
Of course, we already have three cats.
Let's buy a dog instead.
A pet is a big responsibility. Who's going to look after it?
aciklama: Çocuğun bakım sözü vermesi annenin sorumluluktan söz ettiğini gösterir.

soru:
Colleague: I heard you're retiring next month.
Mr Yılmaz: ----
Colleague: That sounds wonderful. You've certainly earned it.
secenekler: Yes, and I'm planning to spend more time in my garden and with my grandchildren.
I don't know who told you that.
Yes, but I'm dreading it. I'll be so bored.
Retirement age is 65 in this country.
No, I've decided to work for five more years.
aciklama: 'That sounds wonderful' Yılmaz Bey'in hoş bir emeklilik planı anlattığını gösterir.

soru:
Receptionist: Good morning, City Dental Clinic.
Patient: Hello, I have an appointment at eleven, but I can't make it.
Receptionist: ----
Patient: Next Wednesday would be fine.
secenekler: You'll have to pay a cancellation fee.
The dentist is on holiday this week.
Is it an emergency?
No problem. When would you like to reschedule?
How long have you had toothache?

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:

soru:
